system.longDesc:
Cost: 2+ SP

In addition to the stunts listed here, pilots also have access to the following Command stunts at the same SP cost: Blinding Maneuver, Evasive Action, On-Target, Misdirect, and Set-Up.

When performing high-g maneuvers, the pilot can lessen the potential damage to passengers by making a smooth transition. For every 2 SP spent, the TN for the Constitution (Stamina) test is reduced by 1.
